name: Jendo: Origins
source:
The beginning of the adventures of Jack and his friends.

After his parents divorced, Jack moved with his father to a small provincial town in the south of the country. Anticipating the chance to start a new school life with good friends and beautiful girls, he gets into serious trouble on his very first day and completely loses hope for it. However, an unexpected meeting with one seemingly nondescript guy forever changes his life.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1449430/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
杰克和他的朋友们冒险的开始。

父母离婚后，杰克随父亲搬到该国南部的一个省级小镇。他期待着有机会与好朋友和美丽的女孩一起开始新的学校生活，但他在第一天就遇到了严重的麻烦，并完全失去了希望。然而，与一个看似不起眼的家伙的一次意外会面永远改变了他的生活。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1449430/]Steam[/url]]
